activity_summary: You stood in the doorway because the cough would not let you sleep. The close was hard frost, each stone rimmed white, with one lit window in Crosby Place and a cat's prints the only other tracks. The puddle by the gate was frozen white and opaque. You were not in the picture.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Stood in the doorway. Not pictured.

entities.name: Crosby Place
entities.context: Mentioned in Frost on the close

facets.activity: Stood in the doorway at the frost
